channel.title: Pier & Point · Block 2
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Block 2 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Block 2: Potrero Block 2's $575 million is now shown as a ceiling: California IBank's staff report asked its board to authorize bonds 'not to exceed' that amount, to be sold to underwriters led by Goldman Sachs. It is not a closed financing and not a construction cost.
item.description: Potrero Block 2's $575 million is now shown as a ceiling: California IBank's staff report asked its board to authorize bonds 'not to exceed' that amount, to be sold to underwriters led by Goldman Sachs. It is not a closed financing and not a construction cost. Source: California IBank staff report, Campus Facilities Improvement Association, board meeting 2025-04-23 (ibank.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/4a-Campus-Facilities-Staff-Report.pdf).
item.source: California IBank staff report, Campus Facilities Improvement Association, board meeting 2025-04-23 (ibank.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/4a-Campus-Facilities-Staff-Report.pdf)

item.title: Correction · Block 2: Block 2 (UCSF): overall completion is now shown as expected by 2030 per the project team (SF YIMBY, Feb 2026), replacing a 'late 2028' date the article does not give. The address is stated as 420 23rd Street, with 249 Craig Ln as the Assessor's address, and the distance to the unrelated parcel it was once matched to is about 125 m, not 250 m. Five DBI permit dates that had recorded the issue date as the filing or completion date were corrected. The financing structure is described as the plan Bisnow reported in May 2025 ($575 million, 'more than half a billion dollars'), the Regents' CEQA document is described as findings put before the Regents, since it does not record adoption, and several citations now point to the article or dataset that states the claim.

item.title: Correction · Block 2: Nine minor building permits move from the timeline to a separate list of building permits: six tieback permits for the shoring system supporting the Block 2 UCSF development, two permits for a temporary exterior facade mock-up, and one administrative City Planning impact-fee permit. None set the record's status, so the status shown does not change. Their cost entries move with them as each permit's own valuation.
